description: Ryan Barley is a software engineer building building AI agents at Fountain Life. Writing his way from mid-level to staff in twelve months of structured study, in public.
lede: I write about the parts of software engineers still have to do.
intro: Software engineer. Currently building AI agents at Fountain Life. Recently finished an MS in Computer Science (AI concentration) at Georgia Tech. Writing my way from mid-level to staff in twelve months of structured study, in public.
aside: Twenty essays this year, written without AI. The Curator, a learning agent I built, grades each one before I publish it, against a standard that rewards real thinking over polish and is harder on me than I would be on myself.
